text.zh-CN: CK 8378 U/L（参考 22–180），LDH 521 U/L；用药前 CK 152 U/L。
text.en: CK 8378 U/L (reference 22–180), LDH 521 U/L; pretreatment CK 152 U/L.

text.zh-CN: 肌纤维肿胀变性、部分断裂及灶性炎细胞；神经传导大致正常。
text.en: Swollen/degenerating and partly disrupted muscle fibres with focal inflammatory cells; nerve conduction was largely normal.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.en: The ECG was reported normal.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 停药并补液补钾、螺内酯及监测后，6 天乏力消失；约 10 天钾 5.1 mmol/L、CK 450 U/L，无不适出院。
text.en: Withdrawal, fluids, potassium, spironolactone and monitoring were followed by resolution of weakness at six days; around ten days potassium was 5.1 mmol/L and CK 450 U/L, with discharge asymptomatic.

text.zh-CN: 严重低钾伴横纹肌溶解，考虑药物关联
text.en: Severe hypokalaemia with rhabdomyolysis and possible medication association

feedback.zh-CN: CK 与钾的变化及用药时序相符。
feedback.en: CK/potassium changes and exposure timing are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 肌力 V 级排除肌损伤
text.en: Grade V strength excludes muscle injury

feedback.zh-CN: 生化和组织已有损伤证据。

text.zh-CN: 没有深色尿就排除横纹肌溶解
text.en: No dark urine excludes rhabdomyolysis

feedback.zh-CN: 典型三联征并非必须齐全。
feedback.en: The classic symptom triad need not be complete.

prompt.zh-CN: 安全管理的重点是什么？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.zh-CN: 停可疑药，监护下纠正电解质并复评肾功能、肌酶及容量
text.en: Withdraw the suspect drug and correct electrolytes with monitoring of renal function, CK and volume

feedback.zh-CN: 严重低钾即使一次 ECG 正常也需认真处理。
feedback.en: Severe hypokalaemia warrants care despite one normal ECG.

text.zh-CN: 心电图正常可回家自行补钾
text.en: A normal ECG permits unsupervised home potassium

feedback.zh-CN: 不能据单次 ECG 排除严重风险。
feedback.en: One ECG cannot exclude serious risk.

text.zh-CN: 仅因肝酶改善就继续原药
text.en: Continue because liver enzymes improved

feedback.zh-CN: 其他器官毒性仍需权衡。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 甘草酸苷暴露后严重低钾伴肌损伤，去激发及纠正后改善；机制与各治疗贡献未独立证明。
conclusion.en: Glycyrrhizin exposure preceded severe hypokalaemia and muscle injury, improving after withdrawal/correction without separate proof of mechanism or each treatment contribution.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 正常 ECG 或肌力不能抵消严重生化异常。
keyReasoning.en: Normal ECG or strength does not negate severe biochemical abnormalities.
